data.title: Car owners' private data leaked, including PM's Rolls-Royce
data.description: The Department of Land Transport (DLT) is investigating how vehicle owners' pivate information was stolen and shared online - including, reportedly, data on the prime minister's Rolls-Royce.

data.title: Fake Thai ID card racket busted in Tak
data.description: TAK - Police have arrested four Thais and seven Myanmar nationals in a crackdown on fraudulent Thai ID card issuance in this border province.

data.title: Border town suffers as Malaysians bypass old checkpoint
data.description: SONGKHLA - The Thai border town that hosts the old — and still operational — border checkpoint with Malaysia has seen business fall off sharply since a new checkpoint opened just a kilometre away.

data.title: Court acquits 'Aem Cyanide' of sixth murder charge
data.description: The Criminal Court has acquitted convicted poisoner Sararat "Aem Cyanide" Rangsiwuthaporn of the sixth murder case brought against her.

data.title: Myanmar ex-junta chief set for first Thailand visit as civilian leader
data.description: NAY PYI TAW — Myanmar's ex-junta chief Min Aung Hlaing is expected in Thailand on Thursday, making his first trip there since becoming civilian leader as he seeks a return to the diplomatic fold for his pariah state.

data.title: Protests force pause in Yala flood retention plan
data.description: A public hearing on the controversial water retention project to prevent flooding in southern Yala city has been put on hold amid growing protests by community leaders and environmentalists.

data.title: Chinese man gets 46 years for illegal Pattaya arsenal
data.description: A Chinese man has been sentenced to 46 years in prison for the illegal possession of military-grade weapons, C4 explosive, signal-jamming equipment and other prohibited military hardware.

data.title: Wild elephant calf dies only days after being rescued
data.description: KANCHANABURI - The newborn elephant calf separated from its herd and then rescued from a jungle stream in this western province last week died early Tuesday morning.

data.title: People's Party accused of proxy voting
data.description: The Democrat Party on Monday called for an investigation into alleged proxy voting by People's Party councillors during a recent Bangkok Metropolitan Council (BMC) meeting, saying it would file a complaint with the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC).

data.title: People's Party rules out future cooperation with Bhumjaithai
data.description: The People's Party (PP) has learned its lesson from supporting Anutin Charnvirakul's bid for the premiership, deputy leader Sirikanya Tansakun said on Monday, apologising to the public and ruling out future cooperation with the ruling Bhumjaithai Party (BJT).

data.title: Royal Forestry Department widens Phuket land crackdown
data.description: The Royal Forestry Department (RFD) on Monday expanded its crackdown on alleged forest encroachment in Phuket, targeting eight locations as part of the government's "Phuket Model" policy to reclaim illegally occupied land.

data.title: People's Party MP, actor, answer DSI summons in forex case
data.description: People's Party (PP) list-MP Pawoot Pongvitayapanu and actor Rattapoom "Film" Tokongsup separately reported to the Department of Special Investigation (DSI) on Monday to acknowledge charges in connection with an alleged illegal foreign exchange (forex) trading scheme.

data.title: Masseuses claim abduction by fake cops
data.description: Three employees of a Pattaya massage shop have accused men posing as police officers of abducting them, threatening to frame them on drug charges and extorting money for their release.

data.title: Polluted rivers spark protest
data.description: The People's Network for the Protection of the Kok, Sai, Ruak and Mekong rivers yesterday protested outside the Myanmar Consulate-General in Chiang Mai, calling for action over mining-related pollution in Myanmar that has affected several rivers in northern Thailand.

data.title: YouTuber's body to return from Georgia
data.description: The Thai embassy in Ankara is coordinating with Georgian authorities to repatriate the body of Thai travel YouTuber Bawornthat "Hlun Solo" Pengsuk after his family authorised the embassy to handle the process, the Foreign Ministry said.

data.title: Si Sa Ket station to  undergo renovations
data.description: Si Sa Ket Railway Station will undergo upgrades to its forecourt, fountain plaza and passenger facilities as authorities prepare for the 44.1-billion-baht Phase 2 double-track railway linking Thanon Chira Junction and Ubon Ratchathani.

data.title: Dig uncovers lost wall section
data.description: NAKHON RATCHASIMA: Archaeologists have uncovered a long-lost eastern section of the Korat city wall, a major discovery not seen in more than two decades.

data.title: Health ministry steps up weed enforcement rules
data.description: The Ministry of Public Health has stepped up enforcement of cannabis rules, revealing the results of operations conducted since October.

data.title: Korrawee to sue iLaw director
data.description: Bhumjaithai MP for Ang Thong Korrawee Prisananantakul on Monday authorised his lawyer to file a defamation complaint against iLaw director Yingcheep Atchanont over allegations linking him to the alleged Senate election collusion case.

data.title: PM blasts UN border report
data.description: Thailand has rejected a UN special rapporteur's report estimating that 650,000 Cambodians were internally displaced during recent border clashes, saying the findings relied on one-sided information and failed to include Thailand's perspective.

data.title: Questions swirl over Bhumjaithai unity
data.description: Although Bhumjaithai (BJT) leaders insist the party remains united, a series of recent developments has fuelled speculation over whether Thailand's dominant coalition partner is facing more than routine political tensions.

data.title: Thailand among top destinations for Koreans in drug‑trafficking cases
data.description: Thailand ranked second only to Cambodia for cases in which South Koreans were caught trying to transport illicit drugs to third countries, according to data compiled by the Foreign Affairs Ministry in Seoul and reported by a South Korean lawmaker.

data.title: Nearly 6,000 civil servants to lose jobs after exam fraud
data.description: The discovery of civil service exam fraud is expected to cost 5,925 local government employees their jobs this month, Deputy Interior Minister Worasit Liangprasit said on Monday.

data.title: Patients seek answers over health data discrepancies
data.description: More than 10 people who found treatments they never received recorded in their digital health histories on Monday petitioned the Public Health Ministry, demanding answers within 15 days or they would pursue legal action.

data.title: Still no clearance to bring dead Thai vlogger home from Georgia
data.description: The Foreign Affairs Ministry is still awaiting clearance from police investigators in Georgia, in eastern Europe, to return the body of Thai Youtuber Hlun Solo to Thailand for funeral rites.

data.title: Malaysia wants proof southern insurgents find shelter there
data.description: Malaysia has requested evidence from Thailand to substantiate reports of armed insurgents fleeing across the border, finding refuge there, after attacks targeting security forces in the far South.

data.title: Fire destroys restaurant, spa in Phuket
data.description: PHUKET - A fire destroyed a three-storey building housing a resort restaurant and a massage and onsen spa in Karon district on Monday morning.

data.title: Deep South police station attacked, school closed
data.description: YALA - Gunmen fired shots at Lam Mai police station in Muang district of this southern border province on Monday morning, causing the closure of a nearby school while students were still arriving for classes.

data.title: Rescued elephant calf recovering but still has diarrhoea
data.description: KANCHANABURI - The starving elephant calf rescued near a fast-flowing stream in Sai Yok district is recovering well from her injuries and is reacting more to her surroundings, but still suffers from diarrhoea and her condition is being closely monitored by veterinarians.
